name: explain-this
description: Create distill-style interactive explainers - single-file, zero-dependency HTML with hand-built canvas figures - from documents, web research, or a codebase, with a fact-checking gate so no incorrect claim ships.

interface.longDescription: Create distill-style interactive explainers from documents, web research, or codebases. The bundled skills produce single-file HTML articles with hand-built Canvas figures and require a fact-checking gate before delivery.
defaultPrompt: Make an interactive explainer about PageRank.
Explain how this repo works as an interactive guide.
Fact-check this explainer against its sources.
